items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: And this Martin fellow, what's his name? ... The drummer, Henry Martin. He worked mostly, though, with the Silver Leaf or the Maple Leaf or something or another.

ctx.x: Well, I mean, he played traps and bass drum, but he's the best on bass drum. But, I mean, he played traps, too, pretty nice. And this Martin fellow, what's his name?
